ABOUT FUSION ELITE

One Vision! One Mission! One Family! — Est. 1993

OUR STORY

Built on Discipline.
Driven by Transformation.

Fusion Elite Performance Training Center was founded in 1993 on a simple but powerful belief: martial arts, taught the right way, transforms lives. What began as a vision to serve the Rocklin community has grown into a second home for hundreds of families — a place where champions are built not just in competition, but in character.

Our expert team — led by Master Instructor Joey Febres alongside Black Belts Alexis Vorbeck, Tim Wilson, and Andrew Witte — blends Taekwondo, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Kickboxing, and Krav Maga with proven youth development principles. We are committed to helping every student grow in confidence, character, and resilience so they believe in themselves and their ability to achieve great things. When you join Fusion Elite, you're choosing more than training. You're choosing transformation.

1993 Year Founded
500+ Students Trained

WHAT WE STAND FOR

Our Core Values

These aren't words on a wall. They're the standard we hold ourselves to every single day — on and off the mat.

Integrity

Doing the right thing even when no one is watching — on the mat and in everything we do.

Perseverance

The determination to keep going even when things are difficult. We never quit — we find a way.

Indomitable Spirit

The unwavering belief that you can overcome any obstacle — the spirit that defines every Fusion Elite student.
